acceptance_definition: A recorded pass of every mandatory criterion in a fixed versioned task contract, on pinned inputs/candidate bytes, independently reviewed and locally integrated. A definition packet may record downstream gaps without accepting dependent behavior.

DEFINE: Primary source number/title/edition and full body identity are pinned. A mismatched or missing primary body fails this criterion; a title alone cannot pass.

Every paragraph/subparagraph in the frozen primary body has exactly one reviewed disposition or explicit multiple typed links; the independently checked paragraph-ID set has zero unexplained omissions.

Every discovered type, variant, attribute, relationship, exclusion, option, service and required child reference has a stable source-qualified identity and locator. Missing referenced bodies remain named dependencies; no invented Cartesian combinations or parentage.

Each required behavior has an independently sourced expected-results case, or a specific unresolved-input record naming the missing rule/source/fixture, dependent output, decision owner, resolution task ID, exact resolution pass condition and next action. Unresolved case records do not count as frozen implementation oracles.

Each case cleared for implementation has exact input hashes, expected outputs, units, numeric tolerances where relevant, criterion IDs and independent reviewer. New estimating policies have owner receipts; unchanged approved rules are reused.

The resulting implementation packet assigns exact code/test paths, consumed/produced interfaces, executable failing tests and implementation steps for admitted behavior. Larger source-supported families receive explicit child tasks; this is not permission to collapse the section’s taxonomy.
RESULT: For every admitted case, deterministic results equal the independently expected counts/obligations; measured values meet that case’s predeclared numeric tolerance and imperial units. No mandatory case is skipped.
All required source, rule, taxon, assembly and work-status identities match the expected result; equal tags or amounts never establish physical identity by themselves.

Positive, missing-input, conflicting, exclusion/option and explicit-duplicate cases match their named expectations. Known subtotals remain visible; required unknown totals are not silently converted to zero.
Every profile-specific case in this section plan passes under its source/rule bindings. A case can be inapplicable only through a prior source-backed contract disposition.
Identical input/source/rule bytes reproduce identical semantic results. Unsupported or stale inputs cannot acquire current quantity authority.

Original-source proposals preserve source/page/region/role identities. Deterministic injection tests and recognition metrics are recorded separately; unqualified recognition cannot satisfy final section qualification.
CONNECT: Import the frozen drawing/schedule/spec sources through the real application; the section view exposes every expected record, written obligation and unresolved item.
All named correspondence, package, responsibility and missing-reference cases match the independently expected links without duplicate procurement or invented supplied documents.
Correct a source-supported attribute, identity or scope decision through the application. Exactly the dependent result IDs change; an unrelated sibling control result retains its identity and value.
Replace the selected source/rule revision. Affected decisions become stale with retained history; unaffected source-bound results stay current.
Save, close and reopen the Mac workflow. Current results, unresolved items, review decisions and append-only history match the recorded expected snapshot.

Excel and evidence PDF contain exactly the expected section rows, supported totals, units, unknown/stale states and source references. Formula results match the independent oracle; neither export silently finalizes incomplete quantities.

Open every distinct required source destination from exported evidence and verify source identity, revision, page and region. A supplied cross-reference is not substituted for the actual referenced document.
The touched shared components pass their affected regressions. The evidence names which changed bytes required those checks; accepted unrelated components are not requalified.
QUALIFY: Every required taxonomy node/variant and verified child section has accepted SC01–SC08 evidence or a justified not-required-by-contract disposition fixed before evaluation. No required unresolved taxonomy or behavior gap remains.

The frozen original-source representative set passes every named extraction/recognition, numeric and permitted-review-burden criterion. Cases, expected results, thresholds and provenance were fixed before the run; generated detections cannot substitute for original-source evidence.

The exact Mac application/package executes import, review, calculation/obligation display, correction, reopen and both exports for the representative set. Record candidate, OS/runtime and evidence identities.

Independent Codex review closes every mandatory criterion finding; optional improvements have separate task IDs. Source-conflict cases may pass only when their expected result is an explicit exception, not when a required supported quantity was missed.

Integration, dossier, complete scoped coverage links, remaining out-of-contract limits and next task are recorded together. Section acceptance is Mac-scoped; it does not claim complete CSI catalogue or Windows delivery.
